Later Applied OO issues FHIR-32787 and FHIR-32788 revisited the same supplemental-code guidance; FHIR-32787 refined body-weight guidance, and FHIR-32788 directed removing the blood-pressure supplement sentence. The combined branch already contains d696144c4669d29fc0a67f35ea28e36e475f93e4 for FHIR-32788.
